scope: Bounded feed replay/retention, summary hydration and per-subscriber projection queue; synthetic disposable Redis, not full public streaming acceptance

implementation.live_broadcast: Sequence notices; no retained full publications
implementation.summary: Separate small hashes for new Redis entries; private fields omitted before retention
implementation.legacy_cancellation: Owned repair task and dedicated timed connection; final driver drop precedes admission release
implementation.oversize_boundary: One intact record may exceed the target; no detection keys truncated
implementation.failed_append: Remove new dedup marker on INCR/XADD failure; restore head on XADD failure

verification.redis_persistence: AOF, appendfsync everysec, matching chart server settings
verification.store_instances_scope: Separate publisher and reader clients in one capped native process, sharing one Redis fixture
verification.caller_abort_during_paused_redis: Admission held until dedicated repair finishes; recovery verified
verification.trimmed_summary_and_dedup_keys: Removed with evicted entries; checked after all 32 appends

build_notes.initial_compiler_exit_137: Explicitly stopped to replace slow Windows-mounted build/cache IO; OOMKilled=false. This was not a runtime test failure.
build_notes.subsequent_builder: Linux-native task-owned Docker build-cache volume, cached for follow-up work
build_notes.cache_volume_contents: Compiler/dependency cache only; no application Redis data
